quizzes.question: 1,900 of 2,000 suspect units have been found and screened. Is containment complete?
options: No — 100 suspect units are still unaccounted for
Yes, if the fix is installed
quizzes.explanation: Containment coverage of 95% means 5% of the suspect population is still out there. Containment is complete only when every unit is accounted for.

quizzes.question: Focus failures jump at test right after a fixture changeover. The tester is reset and passes. What should happen FIRST?
options: Isolate units since the last good setup and record the evidence
Change the fixture back and say nothing
quizzes.explanation: Protect the customer first: hold everything since the last verified setup, keep samples and records, then investigate. Resetting the tester hides the abnormality.
